# Welcome to #📡-fpgas-online
This channel is for developing **fpgas.online**: free remote access to real FPGA development boards, and now Tiny Tapeout boards too, from your browser. Build a bitstream with whatever toolchain you like, upload it, and watch the board on a live camera. @Tim 'mithro' Ansell and @carlfk look after this channel.

**FPGA boards**
- [ps1.fpgas.online](<https://ps1.fpgas.online/>): Pumping Station: One, Chicago (Arty A7 and LiteFury)
- [welland.fpgas.online](<https://welland.fpgas.online/>): near Adelaide, Australia (Arty, NeTV2, Fomu and Acorn)

**Tiny Tapeout boards**
- [tinytapeout.fpgas.online](<https://tinytapeout.fpgas.online/>): Tiny Tapeout demo boards with real open source silicon

**Docs**
- [docs.fpgas.online](<https://docs.fpgas.online/>)
- [Getting Started](<https://github.com/CarlFK/pici/wiki/Getting-Started>)

**Source**
- [fpgas-online](<https://github.com/fpgas-online>)
- [pici](<https://github.com/CarlFK/pici>)

Report broken boards, suggest features, or help with the infrastructure here.
